bla_glutamatergic_principal_neuron.label: pyramidal neuron
bla_glutamatergic_principal_neuron.note: CL:0000598 definition explicitly mentions hippocampus, cerebral cortex, and amygdala as locations. No BLA-specific glutamatergic principal neuron term exists in CL.

bla_pv_basket_cell.label: basket cell
bla_pv_basket_cell.note: CL:0000118 is a general basket cell class covering all brain regions. No amygdala-specific PV basket cell term exists. PCL entries exist for cortical PV basket cells (e.g. PCL:0011257) but not BLA.

bla_axo_axonic_cell.label: pvalb chandelier GABAergic interneuron
bla_axo_axonic_cell.note: CL:4023036 is defined for pallium (cortex). BLA axo-axonic/chandelier cells share PV marker and AIS-targeting morphology but the term is not anatomically scoped to amygdala. CL:4023083 is obsolete (duplicate). This is the best current CL match.

bla_sst_interneuron.label: GABAergic interneuron
bla_sst_interneuron.note: No somatostatin-specific or amygdala-specific interneuron term found in CL. CL:0011005 is the broad GABAergic interneuron parent. A BLA SST interneuron term would be a potential CL contribution.

bla_cck_basket_cell.label: basket cell
bla_cck_basket_cell.note: CL:0000118 covers basket cells broadly. CCK basket cells exist in PCL as mouse-specific cortical types (e.g. PCL:0011255 Large CCK basket cell primary motor cortex) but no general CCK basket cell or BLA-specific term exists in CL.

bla_vip_calretinin_interneuron.label: GABAergic interneuron
bla_vip_calretinin_interneuron.note: VIP GABAergic interneuron terms in CL are region-specific (e.g. CL:4023014 L5 VIP GABAergic interneuron Mmus; CL:4310127 striatal VIP GABAergic interneuron Primate) but none for BLA or amygdala. VIP/calretinin interneuron-selective class in BLA is a potential CL contribution.

bla_npy_neurogliaform_cell.label: neurogliaform cell
bla_npy_neurogliaform_cell.note: CL:0000693 is a general neurogliaform cell class not restricted to any brain region. No NPY-expressing or amygdala neurogliaform term found in CL.

bla_gabaergic_projection_neuron.note: No CL term found for long-range GABAergic projection neurons of the BLA co-expressing SST and nNOS. This population is distinct from local interneurons by projection axon and nNOS co-expression — a potential CL contribution.

central_amygdala_gabaergic_projection_ne.label: GABAergic interneuron
central_amygdala_gabaergic_projection_ne.note: No CeA-specific GABAergic projection neuron term found in CL. CL:0011005 is the broad parent. Central amygdala principal GABAergic neurons are output projection neurons (not interneurons), making a dedicated CL term a potential contribution.

medial_amygdala_gabaergic_neuron.label: GABAergic interneuron
medial_amygdala_gabaergic_neuron.note: No medial amygdala-specific GABAergic term found in CL. MeA GABAergic neurons are heterogeneous subpallial-derived principal cells, not interneurons — a dedicated term would be a CL contribution.

medial_amygdala_lhx9_glutamatergic_neuro.label: glutamatergic neuron
medial_amygdala_lhx9_glutamatergic_neuro.note: No Lhx9+ or ventral pallial-derived amygdala glutamatergic neuron term in CL. CL:0000679 is the broad glutamatergic neuron parent. This molecularly defined population is a potential CL contribution.

amygdala_intercalated_cell.note: No CL term found for amygdala intercalated cells. These are a distinct population of small, densely-packed GABAergic neurons between amygdaloid nuclei. Potential CL contribution.

hippocampus_pyramidal_neuron.label: hippocampal pyramidal neuron
hippocampus_pyramidal_neuron.note: CL:1001571 defined as 'A pyramidal neuron with a soma found in the hippocampus' — exact match to the proposed type spanning CA1-CA4.

dentate_gyrus_granule_cell.label: dentate gyrus granule cell
dentate_gyrus_granule_cell.note: CL:2000089 defined as the principal cell type of the dentate gyrus with elliptical cell body and cone-shaped spiny apical dendrites — exact match.

subiculum_projection_neuron.label: pyramidal neuron
subiculum_projection_neuron.note: No subiculum-specific projection neuron term found in CL. Subicular principal neurons share pyramidal morphology (CL:0000598) but a subiculum-specific term does not exist. Potential CL contribution.

paralaminar_immature_neuron.label: immature neuron
paralaminar_immature_neuron.note: CL:4042028 immature neuron is a CNS-wide term. The paralaminar population (DCX+/PSA-NCAM+/Bcl-2+/NeuN+) persisting into adulthood in human amygdala is a specialised population; no amygdala/paralaminar-specific immature neuron term exists in CL. Potential CL contribution.

basal_amygdala_fear_neuron.note: Functionally defined population (active during fear states in basal amygdala). No molecular markers given; no CL term exists for functionally defined fear ensembles. Not currently a CL contribution candidate without molecular definition.

basal_amygdala_extinction_neuron.note: Functionally defined population (active during fear extinction in basal amygdala). No molecular markers given; no CL term exists. Not currently a CL contribution candidate without molecular definition.

mtl_concept_cell.note: Functionally defined population (concept-selective single-unit responses in human MTL). Defined purely by encoding properties, not molecular markers. No CL term exists; not currently a CL contribution candidate without molecular definition.
